#### Hello, and welcome to my portfolio. I’m Sevan Esaian, a statistician, data analyst, and data scientist who turns complex, multi-source data into insights that drive better decisions, with a current focus on improving long-term pediatric health outcomes. In the tabs above, you can browse selected projects, interactive dashboards (Shiny apps), and SQL and machine learning work across a range of disciplines.
